summary: A person's public profile now correctly shows container-backed games too (e.g. Abiotic Factor), not just local-save games like Big Walk — the earlier version's documented limitation turned out to matter in practice the first time someone checked their own profile. Also fixes the mobile portal layout: the top bar now stays pinned while scrolling, and the bottom nav's raised center button is a real circle instead of a rounded square.
details: nora/web/persons.py's game-profile cross-reference now also checks a container-backed server's player list (one players() call plus one player() detail call per player, capped at 50 — a personal-scale N+1 accepted deliberately rather than adding a bulk endpoint to Pulse for one caller) instead of skipping container-backed games entirely.
The mobile top bar in (portal)/layout.tsx was a plain in-flow block that scrolled away with page content — now `sticky top-0`.
The bottom nav's raised center chat button was a 56x56px box with only 16px corner rounding (rounded-xl), reading as a rounded square rather than a circular FAB — changed to rounded-full.
